Hi Camila —

Thanks for reaching out — happy to answer those. Quick summary below.

- Use case: Clinical triage assistant that summarizes patient intake notes and prioritizes cases for nurses. We'll use LLM outputs to generate structured flags + short summaries that feed into our triage queue.
- Volume: Currently ~8k requests/day (avg ~1–2k users, short prompts). We expect pilot growth to ~50k requests/day in 6 months if initial results look good.
- Timeline: Looking to run a pilot in May and, if successful, move to production by Q3.
- Compliance: SOC2 would be ideal; data residency in US is fine. We also use SSO via Okta.

Any of the proposed times work for me, but Wed 3/24 at 1pm PT is preferred.

Also cc'ing CareTech Ops in case they want to loop in any security folks.

Thanks,
Lily Thompson
Product Manager, CareTech
